name: LavaLink
author: stacloud.dev@gmail.com
description: Egg Lavalink cho STACloud, cai dat tu GitHub releases va ho tro chay bang Java 8, 11, 17, 21, 25.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Shared installer helpers, embedded in egg JSON by sync.py.
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl jq unzip
USER_AGENT='STACloudMultiEgg/1.0 (stacloud.dev@gmail.com)'
fetch() { curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180 -A "$USER_AGENT" "$@"; }
jar_name() {
    case "$1" in ''|-*|/*|*..*|*[!a-zA-Z0-9_./-]*) echo 'Invalid server JAR filename' >&2; return 1 ;; esac
}
download_jar() (
    url=$1
    target=$2
    checksum=${3:-}
    jar_name "$target"
    case "$url" in https://*) ;; *) echo 'Download URL must use HTTPS' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
    tmp=$(mktemp "${target}.download.XXXXXX")
    trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
    fetch -o "$tmp" "$url"
    [ -s "$tmp" ] && unzip -tq "$tmp" >/dev/null || { echo 'Downloaded file is not a valid JAR/ZIP; existing JAR preserved.' >&2; exit 1; }
    if [ -n "$checksum" ] && [ "$checksum" != null ]; then
        printf '%s  %s\n' "$checksum" "$tmp" | sha256sum -c - || exit 1
    fi
    mv -f "$tmp" "$target"
)
install_properties() {
    if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
        fetch -o server.properties.download https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ptero-eggs/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties
        mv server.properties.download server.properties
    fi
}

repo=${GITHUB_PACKAGE:-lavalink-devs/Lavalink}
version=${VERSION:-latest}
asset=${MATCH:-Lavalink.jar}
case "$repo" in *[!a-zA-Z0-9_./-]*|*..*|/*) echo 'Invalid GitHub repository' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
if [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    endpoint="https://api.github.com/repos/$repo/releases/latest"
else
    case "$version" in *[!a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*) echo 'Invalid release tag' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
    endpoint="https://api.github.com/repos/$repo/releases/tags/$version"
fi
# Keep optional tokens out of URLs and command output.
headers=()
if [ -n "${GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    headers=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN")
fi
metadata=$(fetch "${headers[@]}" -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' "$endpoint")
url=$(jq -er --arg asset "$asset" '[.assets[] | select(.name == $asset)] | if length == 1 then .[0].browser_download_url else error("Expected exactly one matching release asset") end' <<< "$metadata")
download_jar "$url" Lavalink.jar
if [ ! -f application.yml ]; then
    tag=$(jq -er '.tag_name // empty' <<< "$metadata")
    case "$tag" in *[!a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*) echo 'Invalid upstream release tag' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
    fetch -o application.yml.download "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$repo/$tag/LavalinkServer/application.yml.example"
    mv application.yml.download application.yml
fi
echo 'Installation completed.'
